note: The text of the game outside the fight and the tutorial: the life actions, events, party, items, houses and the rest. Each line is found by key through GameMessages.text("life", key, {placeholders}); {name} placeholders are filled from the vars the code passes, and a key must exist here and every placeholder must be given (tools/check_data.gd checks both ways). Plurals are two keys (_one, _many) that the code chooses between. Read through GameLocale, so a translation of this catalog works like the others.
